messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error running analysis
parts:
The screenshot was very helpful.  You will see that Distance is trying to write results to a temporary file.  The path to that temporary file begins with


C:\Users\D'Law\....


Distance cannot write to a file that has an apostrophe ' in the path. 


Solution: Use a different username when logging onto this computer--a username without an apostrophe.  That will then have Distance write to a different temporary directory.

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error running analysis
parts:
The message the Distance software is showing is simply a warning, not an
error. The message is stating that usually the average observed group
size is larger than the adjusted group size; however for your dataset,
the average observed group size is smaller than the adjusted group
size. The message suggests this is an unusual situation (but not an
error). You should assess the situation and decide if it is reasonable
that in the field you are not failing to detect small groups at large
distances.
